title: Doozy Vape Co Doozy Legends Tropikana 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Tropikana from Doozy Vape’s Legends collection is possibly the ultimate tropical fruit vape. Juicy fresh Mangoes lend their sunny sweetness to rich, tangy Pineapple and smooth, mellow Lychee for an irresistible taste of the tropics. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
